findings.evidence: Traced MCP/CLI callers and collection->catalog->v3 publication->remote ACK. The old ACK checked only published source hash; the HTTP reader accepted 206; dedup trusted stale catalog hashes and ignored distinct URL provenance. Regression tests now publish a real v3 reference before ACK, reject changed guidance/source/reference and preserve pending diffs, require republication for changed remoteHash with identical local summary, preserve cached snapshots for 206/Content-Range, and retain changed/deleted notes and distinct URLs. Confined source reads reject symbolic-link escape. 57 tests, lint, typecheck and standalone package passed against stable final source.
findings.conclusion: Necessary collection-to-sync corrections implemented while retaining existing host HTML/PDF reading and bounded text download. This is controlled integration evidence, not a live website ingestion audit or proof of semantic completeness.
